name: Dragon Net
summary: Sydney dialup SLIP/PPP ISP (The Hoath Family Trust, Mark Hoath; started 1995, AS7592); used Access One backbone; folded into Bullet Internet ~2006 (DRAGON.NET.AU PTY LTD, ACN 084 888 120).

events.details: Started operations in Sydney (a computer and a few modems).

Folded into Bullet Internet (domain redirected from May 2006). Comcen absorbed Dragon Net in early 2001 — Comcen content on dragon.net.au by 1 Apr 2001; ISP brand dead c.2001, earlier than both prior dates (2006/2004).

refs.label: domain already serving Comcen's site by 1 Apr 2001
takeover notice; domain later became a bare Apache index on angel.comcen.com.au by Dec 2002 and 302'd to Bullet from May 2006
